8216.title: Bounded path ranking evaluates dominated candidates
8216.rootCauseOneLine: The path matcher applies the result limit after eagerly scoring dominated plain and structured candidates.

prReviews.topFinding: The open PR propagates the limit and adds score bounds; its code was not executed.

8216.proposedFix: Propagate the top-k limit and skip lower scoring passes only under conservative strict score bounds, retaining fallback and ties.
8216.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in a second clean trusted checkout. Synthetic in-memory ranking evidence, not UI timing. Trailing-slash exact-prefix queries already skip structured matching. Repro source and exact output embedded inline per reports policy. Existing open PR #8217 prevents a duplicate fix.
